scope: Historical --bml CLI with actual row-bounded IEEE RPN projections and shared causal GQA/KV implementation

projection.layout: GGUF axis zero contiguous; output row j starts at offset + j*n_in
projection.program: bml_dot_program: Zero, Loop(Dup, VarIndexed, Swap, VarIndexed, FMul, FAdd)
projection.constants: None required; scalar returned from execute_full, no StoreResult offset constants
projection.validation: Nonzero dimensions, exact input length, checked index arithmetic and complete weight slice; shared model caller rejects nonfinite or wrong-sized projection results

oracle.causal: Shared independent GGUF fixture from legacy-causal-native.json: zero Q/K, uniform causal attention, two query heads and one KV head, epsilon 3; A, AB, BA, ABA closed-form logits within 1e-6
oracle.backend_parity: Exact equality with native compiler on fixture, full-prefix and incremental
oracle.failure_retry: Early malformed backend results and late output-head failure do not advance committed positions; retry matches fresh full prefix

cli: Both native and --bml emit split UTF-8 byte pieces as é and stop at EOS; --bml rejects too-short capacity, stops at capacity, never truncates the prompt
limitations: RPN uses native IEEE multiplication/addition, not AST/EML symbolic identities.
This evidence does not establish full TinyLlama generation or numerical parity with llama.cpp.
Shared causal attention and norms remain native arithmetic; matrix projections execute through HotLoop.
Full mutation campaign still running on an older source snapshot; no final mutation gate claimed.
